title: The Coming Prince, or the Seventy Weeks of Daniel (11th edition)

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read the OCR text

Summary pp. vi–vii: decree of Artaxerxes in Nisan of his 20th year, 445 BC; 1 Nisan 445 = 14 March (new moon 13 March 445, 7h 9m, from a calculation sent by G. B. Airy, Royal Observatory, 26 June 1877); 69 weeks = 173,880 days of 360-day years, ending 6 April AD 32, the entry into Jerusalem (Zech 9:9); p. 77: "a gap or parenthesis" before the seventieth week, which is "of necessity still future"

access_notes: Read through the Internet Archive OCR text (eleventh edition). Archive metadata gives 1900; the volume itself is undated.
